subject: Starter Allowance segmentation and early-bird discount
messages:
From: Clara Mendoza <clara@fluxlabs.com>
To: alex_martinez@redwood.ai
Date: Sun, 20 Apr 2025 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: Starter allowance & early-bird pricing question

Hi Alex,

Thanks for the demo last week. We’re reviewing Redwood for a cohort program we run for Seed+ founders. Two quick asks from our finance and operations team: 1) can the starter allowance be split across company teams (we often enroll 2–3 startups from the same studio under one billing entity), and 2) do you have an early-bird promo that stacks with the standard cohort credits?

We’re trying to finalize tooling budget by end of month. Attaching our short requirements (flux_promo_request.pdf).

Appreciate a quick run-through — Clara
Clara Mendoza
Head of Platform, Flux Labs

Attachments: flux_promo_request.pdf (PDF)
From: alex_martinez@redwood.ai
To: Clara Mendoza <clara@fluxlabs.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 21 Apr 2025 10:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Starter allowance & early-bird pricing question

Hi Clara —

Really appreciate the note and the deck. Short answers up front: yes, we support splitting a single starter allowance across multiple teams under the same billing account, and we do have a time-limited early-bird top-up for new cohort partners. Details below and one ask for timing so I can confirm approvals.

Quick bullets:
- Allowance segmentation: we can create sub-allocations (studio-level parent billing > child team allocations). Consumption is tracked per sub-allocation and rolled up to parent.
- Early-bird promo: +25% one-time credit on top of the standard starter allowance if you commit to a 6-month cohort package by May 31.
- Stacking rules: the early-bird credit applies before any usage-based discounts; we don’t stack with other promotional overrides.

I’ve attached a draft of the promo terms for review (promo_terms_v1.pdf). If you’re good with the structure, I’ll loop in Pricing to lock the commitment window and create a tailored quote.

Proposed next step: 30-minute call this week to confirm headcount/scoping so I can get Marissa to sign off. Are you available Wed 4/23 10:00–11:00 PT?

Best,
Alex Martinez
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Attachments: promo_terms_v1.pdf (PDF)
From: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
To: alex_martinez@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 22 Apr 2025 09:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Starter allowance & early-bird pricing question

Alex — forwarding Clara’s ask. Quick notes from Product & Pricing POV before we respond:

- Segmentation: Supported but we should cap the number of child allocations per starter allowance to avoid abuse (recommendation: max 4).
- Early-bird top-up: +25% credit OK but requires a minimum cohort commitment (6 months) and a short usage forecast.
- Approval: discounts >20% or credits >$5k require Ben’s sign-off.

Ben — can you confirm whether we can approve a 25% top-up for Flux Labs if they commit to 6 months? Also confirm we’re fine with the 4-suballocation cap.

Marissa
Director, Partner Programs
From: ben_carter@redwood.ai
To: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, alex_martinez@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 23 Apr 2025 14:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Starter allowance & early-bird pricing question

Marissa / Alex —

I’m fine approving the 25% one-time top-up for Flux Labs under these constraints:
- 6-month cohort commitment (documented in SOW)
- Flux provides a 3-month usage forecast and headcount estimate
- Top-up cap at $12,000 total credit value (after which we revisit)
- Allow up to 4 child allocations under a single billing account

If Flux accepts, Alex — prepare a short amendment to the standard promo terms noting the cap and commit window. Also include the HubSpot deal id so Contracts can pick this up: DL-2025-0789.

Ben Carter
VP, Revenue Operations
From: Alex Martinez <alex_martinez@redwood.ai>
To: Clara Mendoza <clara@fluxlabs.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 24 Apr 2025 15:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Starter allowance & early-bird pricing question

Hi Clara —

Thanks for the patience — good news: we can do the program the way you described. Summary of agreed commercial points below for your review:

- Splitting: We will create up to 4 child allocations under Flux Labs’ parent billing account; consumption will roll up to the parent for reporting.
- Early-bird top-up: one-time +25% credit applied to your starter allowance, valid if Flux signs the cohort package for a 6-month term by May 31, 2025.
- Credit cap: the top-up will be capped at $12,000 (total top-up value).
- Deliverables from Flux: 3-month usage forecast + list of participating teams by start of engagement.
- Next steps: I’ll attach a short amendment and a tailored quote in HubSpot (link: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/67890). If that looks good you can reply with approval and I’ll route to Contracts.

If you want to call and walk through the amendment I’m available Fri 4/25 9–11am PT.

Cheers,
Alex Martinez
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Attachments: promo_terms_v1.pdf (updated wording)
